greenmoor_apple.name: Crisp Apple
greenmoor_apple.desc: From the barrel in Greenmoor's quiet corner. Sweet, and still cold.

velassas_collar.name: Velassa's Collar
velassas_collar.desc: A violet charm on a soft band. Worn in your companion slot, it brings Velassa to your heel; take it off and she goes home. While she walks with you, your ranged attacks hit 5% harder and your damage spells and heals are 3% stronger. When you are badly hurt, she leaps in behind whatever is on you and backstabs it.
